title: 第85章 善意提醒无人相信第84章 暗中观察宗门修士
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 次日天光破晓，晨曦穿透薄雾，漫过山峦层林，温柔笼罩整座青玄宗。
一夜休整过后，宗门再度恢复往日的热闹喧嚣。各峰弟子准时晨起苦修、打磨功法、切磋实战、精进修为，一切光景看似与往日别无二致、安稳如常。
只是所有人心底，都深埋着昨日擂台风波的震撼与忌惮。对林寂的畏惧、猜忌与偏见愈发深重，无人敢轻易招惹、无人敢随意非议，却也无一人真正认同他的逆道修行，无人愿意接纳所谓的“天道朽毒、正统伪道”。
昨夜整夜的暗中观察，让林寂彻底摸清了正统修行的致命弊端与腐朽规律，也让他下定决心，放下隔阂与偏见，尝试点醒沉沦虚妄的同门。
他不奢求一朝一夕颠覆万古认知、打破全宗根深蒂固的执念，却也不忍看着无数鲜活的同门，日复一日懵懂苦修、自毁道基、亲手葬送自身道途与生机。
清晨晨练时段，内门修行坪上人声鼎沸、人头攒动。数十名内门弟子齐聚于此，整齐划一运转《清玄御灵诀》，吞吐天地晨曦灵气、锤炼肉身道基、打磨功法奥义，修行氛围浓烈肃穆。
众人神情虔诚肃穆、结印动作规整标准，每一次灵气周天流转都极致圆满，将正统功法的精妙姿态展现得淋漓尽致。在他们根深蒂固的认知中，这般日夜勤勉、恪守正统的苦修，是登临大道、登顶仙途的唯一正途。
就在众人潜心苦修之际，林寂缓步走入修行坪，身姿平静、步履从容，不带半分威压、不含半分戾气。
他的出现，如一石投入静水，瞬间打破了场地的热闹与祥和。
原本交谈切磋、凝神苦修的弟子，动作齐齐骤停，下意识收敛周身灵气、侧身避让。刹那之间，整片修行坪的喧嚣人声瞬间消散，只剩风吹草木的细碎轻响，气氛诡异而尴尬。
无数道隐晦的目光落在林寂身上，眼底交织着畏惧、好奇、疏离与深深的偏见。无人敢主动搭话、无人敢直视对视，整片区域陷入死寂般的安静。
林寂对此全然视若无睹，目光平静扫过全场潜心修行的弟子，清亮平和的嗓音传遍整座修行坪，无凌厉说教、无刻意标榜，只剩纯粹恳切的善意提醒。
“诸位修行且慢。”
众人闻声，尽数停功收势，神色警惕地望向林寂，心底满是疑惑戒备，不知这位搅动宗门风云的特殊弟子，此刻突然开口意欲何为。
林寂目光诚恳坦然，字字清晰、句句属实，坦然道出深埋万古的修行真相：“你们日夜运转《清玄御灵诀》，吞吐天地灵气、日夜精进修为，看似道基稳固、修为日进、前路坦荡，实则每一次修行吐纳，都在吸纳灵气中潜藏的朽毒，日积月累、层层侵蚀自身道根本源。”
“正统灵气暗藏晦毒，宗门功法本源存有先天残缺。修行越勤勉、境界攀升越高，道基腐朽异变便越是严重。长此以往，无需外敌袭扰、无需天劫降罚，你们的道基自会溃烂崩解、灵力自会枯竭溃散，最终壮年陨落、无疾而终。”
一番话语平淡直白、毫无修饰，没有晦涩玄妙的大道理论，没有惊世骇俗的颠覆论调，只是赤裸裸道出世间最真实、最残酷的修行真相。
可话音落下的瞬间，全场弟子神色齐齐剧变，从最初的警惕拘谨，迅速转为错愕、荒谬、不屑与嗤笑。
短暂的死寂过后，整片修行坪瞬间爆发出一片此起彼伏的嘲讽戏谑之声。
“哈哈哈！我还以为林师兄有什么高论，没想到尽是些荒诞不经的胡言乱语！”
“修行之道，唯勤不破，自古勤勉苦修方能登临巅峰，我修行了近十年，从未听说苦修能把自己修死的荒唐道理！”
“简直可笑至极！我青玄宗这套正统功法传承万年、滋养无数大能天骄，若是真有致命缺陷，岂能绵延万古、兴盛不衰？”
“我算是看明白了，昨日擂台侥幸胜出，今日便开始妖言惑众、扰乱人心！果然是邪修本性，自己误入歧途不修正道，便想拉着所有人一同沉沦！”
质疑、嘲讽、鄙夷、斥责的声音此起彼伏、响彻全场，众人心底潜藏已久的偏见与敌视，在此刻彻底爆发、浮出水面。
在他们固化万年的认知里，正统功法完美无瑕、万古无错，顺天修行是唯一坦途。林寂这番颠覆认知的真话，在他们眼中，只是邪魔惑心、颠倒黑白、哗众取宠的虚妄谣言。
一名资历深厚、修为达到凝气巅峰的内门师兄跨步而出，面色冰冷、满眼讥讽，冷声驳斥道：“林寂，你修行诡异、道途偏邪，便以为世间所有大道皆是虚妄？我辈恪守正统、日夜勤勉，步步夯实道基、年年精进修为，根基稳固、寿元绵长，何来腐朽陨落的危局？”
“你自己误入歧途、修炼旁门邪术，不思悔改也就罢了，反倒妄图造谣生事、蛊惑同门、否定万古正统，这般狂妄行径，实在可笑可鄙！”
其余弟子纷纷附和赞同，眼神鄙夷、态度疏离，对林寂的话语全然不屑一顾。
“没错！自己走歪路，便想抹黑万古正统，居心叵测！”
“万年道统传承，岂是你三言两语便能颠覆？简直痴心妄想！”
“奉劝林师兄安分守己，好好备战宗门决赛，不要再妖言惑众、扰乱宗门修行秩序！”
content_en:
The next day dawn broke, and the morning light penetrated the mist, spread over the mountains and forests, and enveloped the entire Qingxuan Sect gently.
After a night's rest, the sect once again returned to its former bustle. The disciples of each peak get up on time in the morning to practice hard, hone their skills, compete in actual combat, and improve their cultivation. Everything seems to be the same as before, stable and stable.
But deep down in everyone's heart, the shock and fear of yesterday's turmoil in the arena were deeply buried. The fear, suspicion, and prejudice against Lin Ji became more and more profound. No one dared to provoke him easily, no one dared to criticize him at will, but no one truly agreed with his unfaithful practice, and no one was willing to accept the so-called "corruption of heaven's way, orthodox false way."
The secret observation last night allowed Lin Ji to thoroughly understand the fatal shortcomings and corrupt laws of orthodox practice. It also made him determined to put aside barriers and prejudices and try to awaken his fellow disciples who were sinking into delusion.
He did not expect to subvert eternal knowledge and break the deep-rooted obsessions of the entire sect overnight, but he could not bear to watch countless living fellow disciples ignorantly practice hard, destroy their own Taoist foundations, and personally destroy their own path and vitality day after day.
During the early morning practice period, the inner gate practice ground was bustling with people. Dozens of inner sect disciples gathered here, running the "Qingxuan Yuling Jue" uniformly, breathing in the spiritual energy of the morning light of heaven and earth, tempering the foundation of the physical body, and polishing the secrets of the techniques. The atmosphere of practice was strong and solemn.
Everyone's expressions were pious and solemn, and their seal movements were regular and standard. Every flow of spiritual energy was extremely perfect, showing the exquisite posture of the orthodox Kung Fu to the fullest. In their deep-rooted knowledge, such hard work day and night and strict adherence to orthodoxy is the only right way to ascend the great road and reach the top of the immortal road.
While everyone was concentrating on the practice, Lin Jie slowly walked into the practice ground, with a calm posture and calm steps, without any pressure or any anger.
His appearance was like a stone thrown into still water, instantly breaking the excitement and peace of the venue.
The disciples who were talking and exchanging ideas and practicing hard all stopped suddenly. They subconsciously gathered their spiritual energy and turned sideways to avoid it. In an instant, the hustle and bustle of people in the entire training ground instantly disappeared, leaving only the soft sound of wind blowing grass and trees, and the atmosphere was strange and awkward.
Countless cryptic glances fell on Lin Ji, fear, curiosity, alienation and deep prejudice intertwined in their eyes. No one dared to initiate a conversation, no one dared to look directly at each other, and the whole area fell into a deathly silence.
Lin Ji turned a blind eye to this, and his eyes calmly swept over the disciples who were practicing attentively. His clear and peaceful voice spread throughout the training ground. There was no harsh preaching or deliberate flaunting, only a pure and sincere and kind reminder.
"Please wait a moment while practicing."
When everyone heard the sound, they all stopped their movements and looked at Lin Ji warily. Their hearts were full of doubts and wariness. They didn't know what this special disciple who had stirred up the sect's situation suddenly wanted to do.
Lin Ji's eyes were sincere and candid, every word was clear and every sentence was true, and he calmly told the truth of cultivation that had been buried for eternity: "You run the "Qing Xuan Yu Ling Jue" day and night, inhale the spiritual energy of the world, and refine your cultivation day and night. It seems that the Tao foundation is stable, the cultivation level is improving day by day, and the road ahead is open, but in fact, every time you practice and breathe out, you are absorbing the rotten poison hidden in the spiritual energy, eroding the root of your own Tao, layer by layer, over time."
"The orthodox spiritual energy is hidden and poisonous, and the origin of the sect's skills is innately defective. The more diligently you practice and the higher your realm climbs, the more serious the decay and mutation of the Tao foundation will be. If things go on like this, there is no need for external enemies to disturb you, and there is no need for heavenly calamity to punish you. Your Tao foundation will naturally decay and disintegrate, your spiritual power will dry up and collapse, and eventually you will fall into your prime and die without any disease."
The words were plain and straightforward, with no embellishments. There were no obscure and mysterious Taoist theories, and no shocking subversive arguments. They simply revealed the truest and cruelest truth about spiritual practice in the world.
But the moment the words fell, the expressions of all the disciples in the audience changed drastically, from the initial vigilance and restraint, to shock, absurdity, disdain and ridicule.
After a short period of dead silence, the entire training ground instantly erupted into a flurry of ridicule and banter.
"Hahaha! I thought Senior Brother Lin had something to say, but I didn't expect it to be all ridiculous nonsense!"
"The only way to cultivate is hard work. Since ancient times, only through hard work can one reach the top. I have been practicing for nearly ten years and I have never heard of the absurd theory that hard work can kill oneself!"
"It's so ridiculous! Our Qingxuan Sect's orthodox exercises have been passed down for thousands of years and have nourished countless powerful geniuses. If it really has a fatal flaw, how can it continue to prosper for eternity?"
"I finally understand. I was lucky enough to win in the arena yesterday, but today I started to confuse people and disturb people's hearts with my lies! It's true that I have an evil nature. I went astray and didn't correct my path, so I just want to drag everyone down with me!"
Voices of doubt, ridicule, contempt, and rebuke echoed throughout the audience. The prejudice and hostility that had been hidden in everyone's hearts for a long time completely exploded and surfaced at this moment.
In their cognition, which has been solidified for thousands of years, the orthodox exercises are flawless and error-free throughout the ages, and practicing in accordance with the sky is the only smooth path. In their eyes, Lin Ji's truth that subverted their cognition was just a false rumor that was deceived by evil spirits, confusing right and wrong, and sensationalizing.
An inner sect brother with deep qualifications and reaching the peak of Qi Condensation stepped out with a cold face and sarcastic eyes. He refuted in a cold voice: "Lin Ji, your practice is weird and your path is evil, so you think that all the great avenues in the world are false? We abide by the orthodoxy, work hard day and night, strengthen the foundation of the Tao step by step, improve our cultivation every year, have a solid foundation, and have a long life, so why is there such a crisis of decay and decline?"
"You yourself have gone astray and practiced other occult practices. It's just that you don't want to repent. Instead, you are trying to spread rumors and cause trouble, confuse your fellow disciples, and deny the eternal orthodoxy. Such arrogant behavior is really ridiculous and despicable!"
The other disciples all agreed, with contemptuous eyes and distant attitudes, completely dismissive of Lin Ji's words.
"That's right! He took the wrong path and wanted to discredit the eternal orthodoxy, with ulterior motives!"
